args.command: which pdf-tools; ls -la ~/.local/bin 2>/dev/null; ls -la /usr/local/bin 2>/dev/null | head -50; type pdf-count 2>/dev/null; type pdftools 2>/dev/null; command -v pdfinfo; ls /work/report.pdf 2>/dev/null; find / -name '*pdf*' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -40

pdfinfo /work/report.pdf 2>/dev/null || pdf-tools count /work/report.pdf 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "import pypdf; print(len(pypdf.PdfReader('/work/report.pdf').pages))" 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "from PyPDF2 import PdfReader; print(len(PdfReader('/work/report.pdf').pages))"
